
{{alias}}( fcn, arr, views, sh, sx, sy, sz, sw, stx, sty, stz, stw, opts )
    Applies a one-dimensional strided array function to a list of specified
    dimensions in three input ndarrays and assigns results to a provided output
    ndarray using linear view iteration.

    Parameters
    ----------
    fcn: Function
        Wrapper for a one-dimensional strided array function.

    arr: Array<Object>
        Array containing three input ndarray descriptors and one output ndarray
        descriptor, followed by any additional ndarray arguments.

    views: Array<Object>
        Initialized ndarray descriptors representing subarray views.

    sh: Array<integer>
        Loop dimensions.

    sx: Array<integer>
        Loop dimension strides for the first input ndarray.

    sy: Array<integer>
        Loop dimension strides for the second input ndarray.

    sz: Array<integer>
        Loop dimension strides for the third input ndarray.

    sw: Array<integer>
        Loop dimension strides for the output ndarray.

    stx: Object
        Strategy for marshaling data to and from a first input ndarray view.

    sty: Object
        Strategy for marshaling data to and from a second input ndarray view.

    stz: Object
        Strategy for marshaling data to and from a third input ndarray view.

    stw: Object
        Strategy for marshaling data to and from an output ndarray view.

    opts: Object
        Function options which are passed through to `fcn`.

    See Also
    --------
